r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

logits_n = r1['logits']
logits_a = r2['logits']

class_vals = {0: 0.0, 1: 0.333, 2: 0.4, 3: 0.667, 4: 1.0}

print("=== FINAL EVIDENCE SUMMARY ===")

preds_n = np.argmax(logits_n[0], axis=-1)
preds_a = np.argmax(logits_a[0], axis=-1)
print(f"   Normal: {[class_vals.get(p) for p in preds_n]}")
print(f"   Ablated: {[class_vals.get(p) for p in preds_a]}")
print(f"   Accuracy drops: {not np.array_equal(preds_n, preds_a)}")

print("\n2. Position independence (MAPPER not AGGREGATOR):")
for inp_i, tok in [(1, 'J'), (2, 'no'), (3, 'oCLrZaW')]:
    if inp_i < l0_mlp.shape[0]:
        diffs = [np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[inp_i,pos] - l0_mlp[inp_i,1]) for pos in range(2,10)]
        print(f"   '{tok}' max pos diff: {max(diffs):.6f} (near 0 = position-independent)")

print("\n3. Non-binary output (MAPPER not INDICATOR):")
# Check spread of writes

print(f"   Write norms per position: {[f'{n:.3f}' for n in writes_norm]}")
print(f"   Variety of norms = {len(set([round(n,2) for n in writes_norm]))} distinct values → non-binary")

print("\n4. Single source (token at own position) - no aggregation across positions:")
print("   Same token, different positions, different contexts → same write")
# J at pos 1 all-J vs J at pos 9 mixed input

    diff = np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[1,5] - l0_mlp[0,9])
    print(f"   J at different pos/context diff: {diff:.6f}")

print("\n=> L0_MLP: MAPPER (token→ratio lookup, non-binary, single-position source)")

import numpy as np

r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
l0_mlp = r2['L0_MLP']

print("L0_MLP shape:", l0_mlp.shape)  # (4, 10, 16)

print("\n=== POSITION INDEPENDENCE TEST ===")
# Same token at different positions → same L0_MLP write?
for inp_i, tok in [(1, 'J'), (2, 'no'), (3, 'oCLrZaW')]:
    diffs = [np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[inp_i,pos] - l0_mlp[inp_i,1]) for pos in range(2,10)]
    print(f"Token '{tok}': max diff across positions = {max(diffs):.6f}")

print("\n=== TOKEN IDENTITY DETERMINES WRITE ===")
# J at pos 1 (all-J, inp 1) vs J at pos 9 (mixed, inp 0)
print(f"J same token diff context+pos: {np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[1,1] - l0_mlp[0,9]):.6f}")

print("\n=== DISTINCT WRITES PER TOKEN ===")
# Tokens in input 0: BOS J LB TPSI V b no oCLrZaW poiVg J
tokens_in_inp0 = ['BOS','J','LB','TPSI','V','b','no','oCLrZaW','poiVg','J']
writes = {}
for pos, tok in enumerate(tokens_in_inp0):
    writes[tok] = l0_mlp[0, pos]
    print(f"  '{tok}' write norm: {np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0,pos]):.4f}")

print("\n=== COSINE SIM BETWEEN DIFFERENT-RATIO TOKENS ===")
for t1, t2 in [('J','no'), ('J','TPSI'), ('no','oCLrZaW')]:
    w1, w2 = writes[t1], writes[t2]
    sim = np.dot(w1,w2)/(np.linalg.norm(w1)*np.linalg.norm(w2)+1e-8)
    print(f"  cos({t1},{t2}) = {sim:.4f}")
